mechanism: Clobazam is metabolized by CYP3A4 and CYP2C19; testosterone may inhibit CYP3A4, potentially increasing clobazam levels, while clobazam may induce hepatic metabolism affecting testosterone clearance.
action: Monitor seizure control and testosterone efficacy; consider baseline and periodic clobazam and testosterone levels if clinically indicated; adjust clobazam dosing if seizures are poorly controlled.
